method: built-in image_gen; one generation per asset; no CLI/API fallback
processing: Generated PNG originals were preserved under the recorded Codex paths. Project assets were center-cropped and optimized with sharp to 960x420 WebP quality 84. The images are decorative and contain no product rules or assessment evidence.
reference_note: Local subject-art and existing mode-art references could not be read by the built-in generator because their Windows paths were rejected before generation. The same established art direction was therefore described in each prompt; no reference image was used.
